page.overview:
Who is Aqualea?

Aqualea is a character in the Super Nintendo Entertainment System version of Wario's Woods. She is fought as the eighth boss in VS. COM mode.

She is a mermaid with a pink tail and blue hair. Aqualea also has fins covering her gills where ears would be on a human. She is slightly taller than Toad. Aqualea bears a strong resemblance to Mad, another mermaid boss from the Nintendo Entertainment System version of Wario's Woods.

Aqualea is very bitter, vain, and overconfident in her own abilities. Aqualea also believes that she is irresistible and that her competitors lose just to be able to face her again. Despite this, Aqualea calls her opponent Toad overconfident as a result of his previous victories.

Before battle, Aqualea is shown clenching her fists down. If she loses, she has her hands on her, shaking her body left and right while bearing a nervous expression on her face. If she wins, Aqualea happily raises her arms up.
